key_insight: IDEAgent reframes research idea generation as a Quality-Diversity search problem, using multi-agent lineage-based evolution to produce ideas that are both strong and meaningfully distinct.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical framework for building AI research agents that avoid redundant outputs by jointly optimizing idea quality and diversity during generation.
method: Multi-agent idea evolution tracked through lineages and historical ancestors
Quality improved via multi-objective feedback, repair, and refinement
Diversity encouraged with sequential memory and explicit comparison against past and rejected ideas
evidence_signal: Evaluated on 32 topics across 8 computer science domains, IDEAgent achieved 3.89× higher Yield than the best baseline and non-zero Yield on 8× more topics.
watch_item: Yield depends on a chosen quality threshold, so results may be sensitive to how quality is defined and calibrated in different domains.
paper_title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
